thread:
incident-bot: Paging: SableWorks (enterprise-sable) — sustained spike of 429s from dedicated pool dw-09. Error rate ~35% over last 5m. Paging SRE on-call @oncall-ryan and eng-runtime. More details: https://internal.redwood/incidents/3067894321

oncall-ryan: Acked. I'm looking.

sre-ana: Observed KV cache evictions on dw-09, sudden burst of tokens with tenant prefix "fed-". Many concurrent sessions reusing same KV keys -> hotshards. Latency and 429s line up with cache churn.

eng-runtime-max: Routing telemetry shows 42% of requests to dw-09 tagged org=sableworks, tenant_prefix=fed-legacy. Suspect federated auth proxy started sending unscoped tokens yesterday (rolling deploy).

account-linda: We can provision temporary burst capacity on the Dedicated contract (up to +10% for 2h) — need approval from ops-sponsor. If we go past 2h we'll need exec sign-off.

pm-omar: I've pinged SableWorks PM and SRE. Customer wants a quick mitigation, they'll accept short redirect to a warm pool and token rotation.

customer-sre-sable: We can rotate the federated tokens and restrict session scope for 15m. We'll do it as soon as you tell us the exact scope to apply. ETA 5m.

eng-runtime-max: Proposed mitigation steps (low-risk first):
1) Add routing override to divert new federated-prefixed requests from dw-09 -> dw-11 (warm spare).
2) Increase dw-11 capacity by +3 GPU temporarily.
3) Apply a temporary ignore-filter on the routing layer to shed requests with tenant_prefix=fed-legacy if source rate exceeds 200rps.
4) Coordinate token rotation with SableWorks.
5) Monitor 429 rate and restore when stable.

oncall-ryan: Executing step 1 now.
```bash
redwoodctl routing override add --from-pool dw-09 --to-pool dw-11 --filter "tenant_prefix=fed-" --expiry 30m
```

ops-bot: routing override applied. Rule ID: rv-3067894321-1. New traffic observed to dw-11.

ops-bot: provisioning request submitted for dw-11: +3 gpus. infra-api job id: infra-job-98231. ETA ~100s.

incident-bot: Update: 429 error rate down to 18% (5m window). Keeping watch.

sre-ana: KV miss rate on dw-09 decreasing, median p95 latency improving from 420ms -> 260ms. Still see a small tail from legacy sessions.

customer-sre-sable: Rotation complete on our side at ts=3067894550. We scoped tokens to readonly-chat for new tokens.

eng-runtime-max: Applying step 3 filter as emergency shed to protect pool: 
```json
{"filter":"tenant_prefix=fed-legacy","action":"shed","threshold_rps":200}
```
(Will remove after 30m)

account-linda: Contract change approved for temporary +10% burst, logged with billing team. I'll open the override; expect billing notice within 15m.

incident-bot: Update: 429s now 6% (5m). Watching for regressions. Marking as mitigation in-progress. If stable for 15m, we'll close.

oncall-ryan: Leaving reroute and filter active. Assign follow-up to eng-runtime-max for postmortem and root-cause with the federated auth team.

pm-omar: Postmortem owner: eng-runtime-max. Customer contact: SableWorks SRE (sable-sre). Next steps: verify federated proxy rollout, add canary routing for token schema changes, and add alert for sudden tenant-prefix concentration.

customer-sre-sable: Thanks team — we'll hold on our side and report if we see anything. Appreciate the quick support. :heart:

eng-runtime-max: Will collect traces and open PR for a routing policy change to more aggressively isolate tenant-prefix hotshards. I'll also add a dashboard widget for tenant-prefix concentration.

oncall-ryan: Closing active page. Retain thread for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
